name: inotify_init1
description: inotify_init1() initializes a new inotify instance and returns a file descriptor associated with a new inotify event queue. It allows specifying flags to modify the file descriptor's behavior, such as setting it to non-blocking or close-on-exec.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Bitwise OR of flags like IN_NONBLOCK to set non-blocking mode or IN_CLOEXEC to set close-on-exec behavior.

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: An invalid value was specified in flags
The user limit on the total number of inotify instances has been reached or the per-process limit on open file descriptors has been reached
The system-wide limit on the total number of open files has been reached
